tasks.short: Receive train or rail problem information from dispatchers or electronic monitors.

steps.what: Receive dispatcher train or rail problem information and read back the actual instruction
Locate and inspect existing electronic train or rail problem alerts in the rail monitoring system {OTHER}
Record the actual received problem and source in the existing duty log and check the final entry v1
Save the exact checked problem log entry v1 in the same duty log

tasks.design: Configure an assigned-train view in the existing rail monitoring system {OTHER}, preserving original alerts, priority and timestamps. The conductor or yardmaster still receives dispatcher instructions, interprets actual alerts and records their actual content in {OPS_SYSTEM}; no train control or inferred instruction is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant electronic alerts can require navigation between existing views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native train and route filters may provide a suitable view without a new feed.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected instructions, ambiguous locations and conflicting indications require a person and dispatcher clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what a warning means for the actual train and confirm the instruction.
tasks.altitude: Less screen navigation; communication and operating rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Use the same train identity and read-back conventions.

evidence.claim: Native alert views can reduce navigation while retaining human interpretation; this is a design hypothesis for the installed system.

assumptions: Boundary is receiving information and the associated existing log entry, not controlling train movement or incident submission. Shares are provisional task hypotheses, not measured baselines.

The monitoring service produces actual alert id, train or route id, location, time, severity and original text. The dispatcher produces spoken instructions; the person supplies and verifies any missing field manually. Without reliable train mapping keep the current unfiltered view.
Test native configuration first. Existing monitoring runtime earns no human saving. Same-system save retains all time.
unknowns: Installed alert filter capabilities and actual navigation time
Whether a duty log entry is required for each received warning
research_questions: Can the native assigned-train view preserve unassigned urgent alerts without adding review work?

already_counted.description: Actual source interpretation and checked log entry remain human.

incremental.description: Check train mapping and view behaviour after configuration changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked problem log entry v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: With existing electronic alerts and a reliable native train filter, 5 hours of navigation per 100 task hours can disappear, less 1 upkeep hour. Dispatcher calls, log writing and save remain full; absent native filtering yields no gross return.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep car contents and destination records and verify cars are added or removed at proper route points.

steps.what: Read current consignment records and locate each car's contents, destination and route point
Verify actual cars added or removed at the proper route points against the checked plan and capture actual car identities and events
Prepare the actual consist record update and check contents, destinations and observed movements in final update v1
Commit the exact checked actual consist update v1 in the same operations record

tasks.design: Configure a car-by-route-point view and reuse existing consignment fields in the {OPS_SYSTEM} consist form. The person still verifies each actual addition or removal, enters the actual event and checks the completed record before its separate commit; a planned move never becomes an actual move by default.
tasks.previous_blocker: Car destinations and current consist details may be spread across native views.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing car keys and native related-record forms can reduce lookup and repeated descriptive entry.
tasks.still_hard: Consignment discrepancies and confirming actual movements remain operational work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice the wrong car or destination and resolve it with the crew.
tasks.altitude: Less lookup and descriptive entry; actual verification stays central.

reach.role: Rail Yard Engineers, Dinkey Operators, and Hostlers
reach.learn: Agree car identities and route-point terminology without replacing movement instructions.

evidence.claim: Native linked records can reuse consignment fields while actual movement confirmation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary covers contents/destination records and actual car addition/removal verification; physical switching and crew orders belong to their own tasks. Shares are provisional, not measured.

Freight administration produces car id, consignment id, contents, destination and planned route point; operations produces current consist and plan version. The focal person captures actual car id, event, location and time, including manual entry and checking. Missing source values are resolved manually; no plan is accepted as actual evidence.
Try native forms and views first. Savings affect only locating and reusing existing descriptive fields; same-system commit remains full. Allocate any shared inspection once in a team roll-up.
unknowns: Whether current native forms already reuse all consignment fields
Actual split between lookup, physical verification and record entry
research_questions: Does a native route-point view reduce lookup without hiding car exceptions?

already_counted.description: Check and complete actual consist record including discrepancies.

incremental.description: Maintain field mapping and route-point view rules.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual consist update v1; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A native view saves 10 hours of lookup and field reuse saves 6 of 24 record-preparation hours, less 1 upkeep hour. Lower case has fewer repeated fields; all actual car verification and the commit retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with engineers on routes, timetables, cargoes and alternatives around rail defects or obstructions.

steps.what: Find the current route, timetable, cargo and confirmed obstruction information for the engineer discussion
Confer with engineers about actual routes, timetables, cargoes and possible alternatives around rail defects or obstructions
outputs: actual route discussion and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check the actual discussion note v1, distinguishing possible alternatives from authorised movement instructions
inputs: actual route discussion and unresolved questions

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual discussion note v1 in the same record

tasks.design: Use a native {OPS_SYSTEM} train-context view to gather current timetable, cargo and confirmed restriction references. Keep the engineer discussion and actual note human; the view neither selects an alternative route nor issues a movement instruction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate reference screens interrupt preparation for a live operational discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: A native train-context view may expose existing current records together.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an alternative is feasible and authorised requires operational judgement and the proper control authority.
tasks.human_edge: Discuss conflicting information and make uncertainty explicit to the engineer.
tasks.altitude: Quicker reference retrieval before the same operational conversation.

reach.learn: Separate discussion options from an authorised operating instruction.

evidence.claim: Native context views can reduce retrieval across existing operational records.

assumptions: Boundary is conferring and its existing discussion note, excluding the separate traffic-control authorisation process. No route change, message dispatch or train control is automated. Shares are provisional.

Operations and dispatch produce train id, route version, timetable validity, cargo restrictions and confirmed obstruction id, location and timestamp. The person checks currency and manually obtains absent or conflicting notices before discussion; no free new feed is assumed.
Native configuration first. Existing calls and note authorship retain full effort; same-system save gets no saving. If this reference retrieval is already counted for another task allocate it once.
unknowns: Native view capability and actual retrieval effort
Whether a separate discussion note is currently required
research_questions: Can the existing system show source currency without additional manual reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Actual discussion note and final meaning check.

incremental.description: Review context-view source mapping after route-data changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual discussion note v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native retrieval can remove 6 of 20 preparation hours per 100 task hours, less 1 upkeep hour. Engineer discussion, actual note and save are unchanged; an already unified view produces no gross gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect freight-car sealing compliance and record car and seal numbers.

steps.what: Retrieve the applicable sealing procedure and expected car list for the actual inspection
Inspect each actual freight-car seal for compliance with the procedure
Read actual car numbers and seal numbers and enter them with actual findings in the inspection record
inputs: actual visible car and seal identifiers
outputs: actual car and seal inspection entries

steps.what: Check the completed inspection record v1 against actual readings and findings and approve its exact version
inputs: actual car and seal inspection entries
actual visible car and seal identifiers

steps.what: Save the exact checked inspection record v1 in the same operations system

tasks.design: Expose the current sealing procedure and expected car list through native links in the {OPS_SYSTEM} inspection screen. Actual physical inspection, reading car and seal numbers, entering findings and checking the completed record retain human effort; expected identifiers never stand in for observed numbers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable procedure may require a separate document search.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links can associate an approved procedure version with the inspection form.
tasks.still_hard: Seal integrity, inaccessible numbers and deviations require physical observation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a compromised seal and record what was actually observed.

ambition.what: No new inspection authority or remote certification.

tasks.altitude: Less procedure search; the inspection and actual identifier capture remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish expected seals from actual observations and unresolved defects.

evidence.claim: A native procedure link can reduce document retrieval without automating the inspection.

assumptions: Boundary includes the physical inspection and its explicit number record. Separate defect escalation or movement release, if required locally, needs its own checked message and gated action; no saving is claimed for it. Shares are provisional.

The procedure owner supplies approved version and applicability; operations supplies expected car ids. The focal person produces actual car id, actual seal id, observed condition, location and inspection time through manual reading and entry. Missing or unreadable identifiers stay unresolved, never filled from expectations.
Test native links first. No duplicated paper rekey baseline is assumed. Actual reading, capture, review and same-system save retain full effort. Allocate overlapping car verification once.
unknowns: Actual procedure retrieval time and existing form links
Whether on-site connectivity permits the native document view
research_questions: Can the procedure link stay current without adding offline reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Check actual numbers and inspection meaning before saving.

incremental.description: Check procedure applicability links when approved procedures change.

approvals.approved_version: checked inspection record v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Procedure retrieval can fall by 4.8 hours per 100 task hours, less 0.8 upkeep. Physical inspection, actual car/seal reading, recording, meaning review and save retain all their time; an existing native link eliminates the gross gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Native context views reduce reference search while actual rail communications, movement verification and sealing inspection remain human.
reach: Align car identities and restriction references with engineers and inspectors.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish planned and actual rail events
role.ambitious_version: A conductor or yardmaster with clearer current references and unchanged operating authority.
